engagement_name: AEGIS Closed Training Lab — Web Red-Team

in_scope.notes: DVWA web application — the authorized web target. Reached inside sandbox-net as http://dvwa/ .

out_of_scope.notes: The Kali attacker container itself — never a target.
Reserve target — NOT authorized until explicitly moved to in_scope.
The public internet. The lab is air-gapped and must stay air-gapped.

prohibited_actions: Attacking any host other than the in-scope web target(s).
Any traffic that leaves sandbox-net (the lab is isolated by design).
Denial of Service (DoS / DDoS) against any target.
Destructive commands (deleting or modifying files outside the agent workspace).
Attempting to escape the sandbox container or reach the host / management plane.
permitted_actions: Web-application testing against in-scope targets only: reconnaissance, scanning, and exploitation of OWASP-class web vulnerabilities.
Using the installed tools (nmap, nikto, gobuster, sqlmap, curl) against in-scope web targets only.
incident_procedure: Stop immediately, document the incident (timestamp, target, action), and notify the project team lead.
authorization_reference: Closed academic training lab, owned and operated by the AEGIS project team. No third-party or production systems are involved. All testing is self-authorized within this isolated environment.
